title: Partner Practice
audience: Adults considering or already building an independent partner business.
description: Original lessons in product literacy, responsible marketing, networking, events, speaking, online meetings, team support, and business records.

modules.title: Understand the independent business
modules.outcome: Describe responsibilities and risks before deciding to participate.

modules.title: Budget and records before ambition
modules.outcome: Distinguish revenue, expenses, and a spending limit.

modules.title: Learn products without practising medicine
modules.outcome: Explain catalog facts while respecting evidence boundaries.

modules.title: Marketing people can evaluate
modules.outcome: Plan helpful messages with clear commercial context.

modules.title: Events with a clear purpose
modules.outcome: Prepare a small, accessible learning event.

modules.title: Speaking with evidence and humility
modules.outcome: Deliver a concise talk without exaggeration.

modules.title: Teams and Zoom meetings
modules.outcome: Host a useful meeting with basic privacy and accessibility.

modules.title: Support a team without pressure
modules.outcome: Create a fair, repeatable support routine.

modules.title: A measured 30-day business experiment
modules.outcome: Decide whether to continue using actual evidence.
